question: Schedule now as a POC and enter implementation with this bar, committed before any run? Recommended bar: five probes, three runs per arm on Sonnet (30 runs); pass when the index arm follows the probed rules at least as often as the whole-README arm in total, is worse on no probe by more than one run, and loads at most a quarter of the whole-README words at startup. Approving accepts that bar; say a different one if you want it.

artifacts.summary: Seed: the Captain asked whether the README can be read as an index plus per-moment rules instead of all at once, and to prove it is better before continuing. The POC first checks what Spacedock and kc-dev-flow-2 already load per moment (FO boot, show-stage-def, context-sections, mods), then compares the whole README with an index arm built in a scratch copy, on probes drawn from the rule classes the observer reports most (32 violation lines in 15 reports since 2026-10-13). It changes no package or adopter file. Cost not measured; it is reported per run. A restructure task is filed only if the POC passes.
